system.description:
Opposed Strange vs Grit against an enemy within Medium Range (50 ft). On a win, that enemy makes a Strike against itself or another enemy (your choice) with any weapon it is using or any ability it has. Doom +3.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.69
system.summary: Opposed Strange vs Grit against an enemy within Medium Range (50 ft). On a win, that enemy makes a Strike against itself or another enemy (your choice) with any weapon it is using or any ability it has. Doom +3.

automation.label: Opposed vs the targeted enemy's Grit
automation.onSuccess: The enemy Strikes itself or another enemy of your choice with one of its weapons or abilities.

automation.note: The Director rolls the enemy's Grit and sets the CR so you need more successes. On a win, the Director makes the enemy's Strike against the target you choose.
